title: Momentum in large-batch training: Polyak enlarges the critical batch size, Nesterov improves data efficiency
summary: We study when and how momentum improves large-batch training in the one-pass regime, using power-law kernel regression as a tractable setting. We first characterize risk stability through the critical learning rate, defined as the largest learning rate for stable training, and obtain $η_{\mathrm{SGD}}^{\mathrm{crit}}\eqsim 1$, $η_{\mathrm{Polyak}}^{\mathrm{crit}}\eqsim \min\{1,B(1-ρ)\}$, and $η_{\mathrm{Nesterov}}^{\mathrm{crit}}\eqsim \min\{1,B^β(1-ρ)\}$, where $B$ is the batch size, $ρ$ is the momentum factor, and $β>1$ is the capacity exponent.
